title: Site Example — Test Website
meta_description: A public test website with various data types — recommended as an example target for QA automation, end-to-end testing, web scraping, and SEO tools.
text:
Site Example
A public test website. Use it to test scrapers, SEO tools, link checkers, form handlers, and anything else that interacts with web pages.
All email addresses on this site are dummy and none of them are monitored.
      Recommended for QA automation & testing.
      
    This site is intentionally published as a stable, public example for QA automation, end-to-end and integration test suites, web-scraping practice, and demos. You are welcome to point automated tests, crawlers, and coding-assistant examples at these pages and their form/table/link/media/file/API endpoints.

title: Files — Site Example
meta_description: Downloadable test files in various formats: CSV, JSON, XML, TXT.
text:
Files
Downloadable sample files in various formats for testing file handling and parsing.
Available Files
| File | Format | Description | Download | 
|---|---|---|---|
| sample.csv | CSV | Comma-separated values with user data (5 rows, 5 columns) | [Download](/files/sample.csv) | 
| sample.json | JSON | JSON object with users array and metadata | [Download](/files/sample.json) | 
| sample.xml | XML | XML document with user records | [Download](/files/sample.xml) | 
| sample.txt | TXT | Plain text file with sample content | [Download](/files/sample.txt) | 
API Endpoint
A JSON API endpoint is also available with CORS headers enabled:
Returns the same user data as sample.json, served with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *.

title: Media — Site Example
meta_description: Test page with HTML5 video, audio, and embedded media.
text:
Media
HTML5 video, audio elements, and embedded content.
HTML5 Video
HTML5 <video> with controls, poster image, and fallback text. Source: W3Schools sample video.
HTML5 Audio
HTML5 <audio> with controls. Source: W3Schools sample audio.
Embedded SVG Animation
Inline SVG with <animate> — no JavaScript required.
Picture Element
The <picture> element serves different images based on viewport width.

title: Forms — Site Example
meta_description: Test page with all HTML form input types and validation.
text:
All HTML input types and form features. Forms submit via GET so you can see the values in the URL.
There is a hidden field with name="hidden_field" and value="secret_value".

title: Images — Site Example
meta_description: Test page with various image formats, sizes, and loading strategies.
text:
Images
Various image formats, sizes, and attributes for testing image handling.
Standard Images
Image Without Alt Text
Accessibility tools should flag this.
Empty Alt Text (Decorative)
alt="" indicates a decorative image.
Lazy-Loaded Image
Uses loading="lazy" attribute.
Responsive Image (srcset)
Uses srcset and sizes for responsive loading.
Figure with Caption
Inline SVG
SVG rendered directly in the HTML, not as an external file.
Broken Image
The src points to a non-existent file. Useful for testing error handling.
Image as Link
Image wrapped in an <a> tag.
Background Image (CSS)
Applied via inline CSS background-image.
